details:
All 10 acceptance criteria for Task 3 (Task list view) are satisfied:

1. Navigating to `/` renders the task list view — PASS. `urls.py` maps `""` to `TaskListView`; `test_get_returns_200` confirms 200 status.

2. Only incomplete chores shown — PASS. View filters `completed=False`; `test_only_incomplete_chores_appear` verifies completed chores are excluded.

3. Chores sorted by due date ascending — PASS. View orders by `due_date`; `test_chores_ordered_by_due_date_ascending` confirms earliest first.

4. Same due date → ordered by created_at (oldest first) — PASS. View orders by `due_date`, `created_at`; `test_chores_with_same_due_date_ordered_by_created_at` confirms stable tiebreaker.

5. Each row displays title, due date, assignee, priority — PASS. Template renders all four; `test_row_displays_title_due_date_assignee_priority` confirms.

6. Empty optional fields render as placeholder — PASS. Template shows "Unassigned" for empty assignee and "—" for empty priority; `test_empty_assignee_shows_placeholder` and `test_empty_priority_shows_placeholder` confirm.

7. Clicking a row navigates to task detail — PASS. Template wraps card in `<a href="{% url 'task_detail' chore.pk %}">`; `test_chore_row_links_to_detail_view` confirms href present.

8. Empty-state message when no incomplete chores — PASS. Template shows "No chores yet — add your first one"; `test_empty_list_shows_empty_state` and `test_empty_state_shows_message_and_create_link` confirm.

9. List re-renders after chore creation (redirect back) — PASS. `CreateChoreView.post` redirects to `task_list` after save; `test_post_valid_data_creates_chore_and_redirects` confirms 302 redirect to list.

10. Responsive / no horizontal overflow — PASS. Base template has viewport meta tag; CSS uses `max-width: 720px` and mobile media queries; `test_view_is_responsive_viewport_present` confirms viewport meta.

All 43 tests in the suite pass. No code was modified.
